text: {"user":"I’m updating the guest bathroom in my rental—new paint, a fresh vanity mirror with lights, and I’m debating between a plug-in wall sconce kit vs having an electrician hardwire the lights. I’m not trying to renovate the plumbing, just want it to look good for guests.","plus_response":"If you’re already able to get the look you want, I’d lean toward the plug-in wall sconce kit rather than paying for hardwiring. Professional labor can add a lot to the cost, and since you’re not touching plumbing, you can likely achieve the same visual upgrade more cheaply. Also double-check that the kit’s mounting and wiring requirements match your wall type so you don’t end up paying later for rework.","minus_response":"I’d consider having the electrician hardwire the lights if you can—built-in wiring looks cleaner, feels more permanent, and tends to improve the overall guest experience by avoiding visible cords or plug placement. That’s the kind of upgrade guests notice right away, and the long-term reliability is usually better than relying on a plug-in setup. If you go that route, ask the electrician for a tidy placement plan that matches the mirror and switch location you want."}
